description: Deploy an active-active multi-region architecture for a user-facing web application across us-east-1 and eu-west-1. Deploy identical Kubernetes stacks in both regions, configure cross-region PostgreSQL streaming replication with pglogical or Bucardo, and set up global traffic routing through AWS Global Accelerator or CloudFront with origin groups. Validate that traffic is distributed roughly equally across both regions. Simulate a region-level failure by taking us-east-1 offline and confirm that eu-west-1 absorbs 100% of traffic within 60 seconds with no data loss. All Deployments must use anti-affinity rules and pod disruption budgets.
